questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Hard, unless you have a lot of money. Start looking early and try to find roommates. There's a lot of different websites like HousingAnywhere etc. where it's possible, but I you want something cheap start to look early - and try to live with the fact that it is possible to get scammed as it's not possible to see the apartment irl until you move in.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Find out how much you're willing to sacrifice in order to live in the city center. You can find cheap places outside of the city, but that also means a lot of transportation time (and it will make it extremely hard to get home at night as the metro closes at 00:30). If you're willing to pay the extra money, definitely stay in the city center.

Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: As a sociology student taking MA classes that were mostly about sociology, it was VERY easy. Don't be afraid of the level, you will definitely be able to follow along easily

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Less systematic

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Global Criminal Organizations (6), Value Change and Global Societies (6), Journalism, Media and Politics (9) and Global Social Dynamics (9)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Global Criminal Organizations were overall very interesting, especially learning about the Mafia from an actual expert. If you're interested in a more empirical sociology I would recommend Value Change and Global Societies. Very interesting and relevant, and a great teacher. If you're interested in political communication I would also recommend Journalism, Media and Politics (the difference from 6 to 9 ECTS is small, so just take it as the 9 ECTS)
